verdict.rationale: Granola documents a RESTful API with a published OpenAPI 3.1 spec, /v1 notes and transcripts endpoints, AI summaries and a live playground. Workspace members can create their own scoped API keys, but only on Business or Enterprise plans. Action items appear only as something a developer extracts from notes, not as a documented API field, and per-key scopes may limit access to every meeting. Missing for 10: action items as a first-class API output, self-serve keys on all plans, independent hands-on corroboration of scripted pulls.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, my scripts can pull transcripts, summaries, and action items from every meeting through a documented API with self-serve keys

citations.quote: The Granola API lets you build custom integrations with programmatic access to meeting notes, transcripts, and AI summaries.
Any workspace member on a **Business** or **Enterprise** plan can create API keys.
When you create an API key, you choose which note access scopes it should include.
Extract action items from meeting notes and automatically create tasks in Linear, Jira, Todoist, or your project management tool of choice.
